integrity: Proof supplies an edge-product reduction, exhaustive disjoint support cases, a four-state trace formula and a Perron growth argument. Complete finite enumerations are reproducibility checks rather than infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: The statement classifies prescribed square roots only for targets in the second radical power of the truncated oriented-cycle algebra of Loewy length three. Its image law concerns squares of radical elements, not the full algebra. Full-support toric fibers are pre-existing mathematics, not claimed original. Possible equivalent graph-monomial-map formulations may exist; no independent audit has occurred.
title: Singular square-root fibers and square-image entropy in cyclic Loewy-three Nakayama radicals
